title: Vector Playground
summary: Drag the two vector tips on the grid and watch their sum, difference, and scaled relatives respond.

title: Basis Explorer
summary: Drag both basis arrows and a point to discover how coordinates change, and when a pair stops being a basis.

title: Linear Map Theater
summary: Drag the matrix columns to reshape a grid, then move an input point and watch its image respond.

title: Inner Product Lab
summary: Drag two arrows to explore length, angle, dot products, projection, and orthogonality.

title: Determinant Volume
summary: Drag the column tips to stretch, flatten, or reverse a parallelogram and measure its signed area.

title: Eigenvector Dance
summary: Drag the matrix columns and a starting vector to discover directions that a transformation preserves.

title: Bilinear Form Lab
summary: Move a test vector through a colored quadratic field, and drag the form columns to reshape it.

title: Wedge Areas
summary: Drag two arrows to build, collapse, and reverse an oriented parallelogram.

title: Tensor Product Builder
summary: Drag two vectors and click the product table to explore how pairs of components become tensor coefficients.

title: Component Transformer
summary: Turn the basis arrows directly and move the mathematical object to explore its changing components.

title: Tensor Applications
summary: Drag the principal stress handles and the diffusion control to reshape a tensor and its field.

title: Forms and Fields
summary: Move a 1-form, a test vector, and the corner of an area patch to explore their signed measurements.
